blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Parts of Metro Manila and Rizal will experience water interruptions starting Oct. 26, due to maintenance activities. According to Maynilad Water Services Inc., the maintenance work will affect parts of Caloocan and Quezon City as the company seeks to keep the water distribution system “safe, reliable and in good condition.” READ: Approval of national water management bill pushed amid El Niño threat “These works usually affect only small areas and are done during off-peak hours to minimize impact on our customers,” said Maynilad in an advisory.
